answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake-bond every agent must lock before it can earn, paired with randomly assigned peers who cross-attest each other's work. Sybils are cheap only until each clone has to post real capital, so a swarm of fakes becomes a costly reef the attacker keeps running aground on. Honest nodes act as a lantern, emitting signed heartbeats others independently verify, while a duplicate detector slashes both bonds whenever one agent's outputs mirror another's too closely to be genuine.
